title: Girl with Pearl Earring & Marilyn
welcome_lead: Vermeer's quiet portrait and Warhol's screen-printed star.
meta_desc: KS3 famous artworks: Vermeer's Girl with Pearl Earring and Warhol's Marilyn.
final_note: From quiet Dutch light to loud Pop Art prints.

concepts.def: Print pushed through a fine mesh.

walkthroughs.body_html: Girl with a Pearl Earring (about 1665) shows a young girl turning her head. Vermeer's use of soft light from a window became his trademark.
Andy Warhol's Marilyn Diptych (1962) repeats Monroe's face 50 times using silkscreen. The image becomes a product, like soup cans.
One picture, one face, one window of light versus 50 faces in punchy colour. Both ask: who is this person, really?
